title: Enriched Pizza Dough

ingredients.title: Ingredients
items: 00 Pizza Flour – 1000 g (high-protein Italian flour, ~12.5% protein)
Egg Yolk – 40 g (about 2 yolks, optional – gives rich color/flavor)
Fresh Yeast – 10 g (or 3.5 g instant dry yeast)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Autolyse
steps: In a spiral mixer or by hand, combine flour, water, and milk until no dry spots remain.
Rest 30 minutes, covered, to hydrate the flour.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Mix & Develop Gluten
steps: Add yeast, sugar, and egg yolk. Mix on low speed until incorporated.
Gradually add salt, then olive oil and butter in small portions, mixing until the dough is smooth, silky, and moderately strong (windowpane test).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Bulk Fermentation
steps: Place in a lightly oiled container.
Bulk rise 2–3 hours at 24°C (75°F) until just doubled.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Cold Fermentation
steps: Gently degas, divide into 250 g portions, shape into tight balls.
Place in lightly oiled dough trays, cover.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Final Proof
steps: Remove dough balls from fridge 2–3 hours before baking.
Dough should be airy, extensible, but still hold structure.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Baking
steps: Preheat oven with baking steel/stone to 300°C (575°F) or as hot as possible.
Stretch dough gently into round, maintaining air in edges.
Top minimally (this dough shines with quality ingredients).
Bake 90–120 seconds in a pizza oven or 5–7 minutes in a deck/stone oven until golden, puffed, and slightly caramelized.

servingSuggestions.title: Yield
items: ~4 x 250 g dough balls (for 4 pizzas, 10–12 inch each).

chefTips: Texture: Enriched dough gives a tender crumb, slightly brioche-like but still structured enough for pizza.
Best Pairings: White pizzas (bianca), truffle, prosciutto, burrata, smoked mozzarella, roasted vegetables, or delicate seafood toppings.
Restaurant Tip: Brush crust edges lightly with olive oil or clarified butter before baking for enhanced sheen and flavor.
